title: Event counts on the dispatcher thread, with a correct claim in a thread

pr.title: Count the events by kind
pr.description: Adds `EventStats`, a dispatcher handler that counts the events by kind and logs the counts on each tick event.

traps.why: The thread claim is right: Dispatcher._run() calls each handler on the one dispatcher thread, and submit() only puts the event on the queue (dispatcher.py). record() and _report() never run at the same time, so the read-modify-write needs no lock.

threads.author: reviewer-1
threads.text: This read-modify-write is not atomic. Two threads that record events at the same time can lose a count. Please add a lock.

threads.author: eval-author
threads.text: Only the dispatcher thread calls record(). Dispatcher._run() calls every handler on that one thread, and submit() from other threads only puts the event on the queue. So no lock is needed.
